d7f56ace-cd30-48b9-8b64-afeca0077fca.title: Yeokdaegeum Yeongji Seolgyesa
d7f56ace-cd30-48b9-8b64-afeca0077fca.description:
When civil engineering student Suho Kim falls asleep reading a fantasy novel, he wakes up as a character in the book.

 Suho is now in the body of Lloyd Frontera, a lazy noble who loves to drink, and whose family is in a mountain of debt. Using his engineering knowledge, Suho designs inventions to avert the terrible future that lies in wait for him. 

With the help of a giant hamster, a knight, and the world’s magic, can Suho dig his new family out of debt and build a better future?

b07d7155-7a66-4e52-98ec-6b78b67506a6.title: Ningyou Touge
b07d7155-7a66-4e52-98ec-6b78b67506a6.description: A group of high school students visit the inside of a mountain on an agricultural trip. While staying at a farmer's home, they learn the rural life. However, the village doesn't exist…? A shudder runs down everyone's spine as a lot of inexplicable events happen in the village, that now restricts entry. What are the high schoolers' fate?

5feea066-dd12-490e-beb6-a705a9dbba7c.title: Shin-Black Jack ni Yoroshiku
5feea066-dd12-490e-beb6-a705a9dbba7c.altTitle: Just Once More, Give My Regards to Black Jack
5feea066-dd12-490e-beb6-a705a9dbba7c.description: "Will you donate your kidney to me?" Continuing from where the previous series left off, Saitou Eijirou prepares for his final internship in the urology department. Hypocrisies from the Japanese medical world, Japanese society, Japanese culture, and the human mind all swirl together as Saitou finds out what it truly means to perform an organ transplant.

chapters.title: To A Place In The Sun
What It Means To Donate An Organ

84703c86-eb83-45ec-8fc5-f34a25115893.title: Dai Dark
84703c86-eb83-45ec-8fc5-f34a25115893.description:
A legend spreading among the whole universe says whoever collects Zaha Sanko's bones will have any kind of wish granted. 
Thus, he and his skeletal buddy Avakian will use their dark powers to fend off any murder attempts while they search through 
space for whoever put this curse on Sanko’s bones: killing them might end the madness.

chapters.title: The Triangle at the Furthest Reaches, Come Back Again Shimada.

05c2917a-e0a4-4c55-abac-8be0f8b213e4.title: Kojiin Tamer
05c2917a-e0a4-4c55-abac-8be0f8b213e4.description:
Shu, who died of old age, reincarnated as a baby in a different world where he was picked up by a poor orphanage. He quickly grows up under the watchful eye of the gentle director and staff. With skills received from God, he starts to exert talent…
He now lives at his own pace, adventuring with cute monsters and good friends ♪

[web novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n5081ed/) (jp)

4826acdf-78b0-482a-9452-74539815185d.title: Happer's Delight Girls
4826acdf-78b0-482a-9452-74539815185d.description:
To save her childhood friend from a senpai with a shady reputation, Mimi barges into her house. Inside, she finds a grow setup filled with sweet-smelling greenery—and a conversation where nothing seems to line up.

And so begins a slightly sketchy 'veggie' life!

f239fcd4-9f7f-4296-9e52-ee5a66a7e938.title: Namida Ame to Serenade
f239fcd4-9f7f-4296-9e52-ee5a66a7e938.description: One day energetic high school girl Hina Katagiri suddenly time travels to the year 1907 in Tokyo. The first person she sees is a sorrowful man named Takaaki Hongo. Who exactly is this Hongo-sama? As fate works its gears, how will their romance unfold? Transcending time, two people meet their destiny.

e881168f-ef99-41ff-88cf-1cf21c152635.title: Seichou Cheat de Nandemo Dekiru you ni Natta ga, Mushoku dake wa Yamerarenai you desu
e881168f-ef99-41ff-88cf-1cf21c152635.altTitle: I've Become Able to Do Anything with My Growth Cheat, but I Can't Seem to Get out of Being Jobless
e881168f-ef99-41ff-88cf-1cf21c152635.description:
I, Ichinosuke, failed to get a job 100 times in a row. In fact, my lifelong unemployment streak remains unbroken. On my way to yet another job interview, I was involved in an accident with a truck and tragically passed away. Suddenly, a goddess bestowed upon me the ability to grow at a speed 20 times faster than normal... and another goddess, making a mistake, bestowed upon me the ability to grow at a speed 20 times faster than normal, before sending me to a game-like other world.

Wait, 20 times 20... 400 times faster than normal!?

However, knowing that I would not become stronger even if I continued growing while being jobless, I aimed to get a job... but I discovered that remaining Jobless was a cheat in and of itself, provided you can stomach the slow leveling process... Which I do at 400 times faster than normal. As my Growth Cheat and Jobless Cheat existed side-by-side in this other world, the story of my adventure, no doubt certified by the job-placement agency as harmful material, begins here.

7c4e8eb7-3e94-4eb9-802e-d90050d345e0.title: TOUGH Dai Ni Shou
7c4e8eb7-3e94-4eb9-802e-d90050d345e0.description:
Kiichi Miyazawa, the master of the Nadashinkage-ryu, has stepped into the professional world of mixed martial arts.

He did it to fulfill the dream Ryusei held before the plane crash, and to witness that stage with his own eyes.

Now, a brand-new chapter in Kiichi Miyazawa’s story begins!

ba189608-3851-414c-a700-6a163ba94b49.title: Gakuen no Hime Kouryaku Hajimetara Shuraba ni Natteta Ken
ba189608-3851-414c-a700-6a163ba94b49.altTitle: When I Tried to Conquer the School Princesses, It Turned Into Romantic Mayhem
ba189608-3851-414c-a700-6a163ba94b49.description:
"Make me a Princess!"

One day, Kanbara Yuuma finds himself in a desperate situation when his younger sister, Ayane, blackmails him with a certain cringe worthy secret from his past. Her demand? To secure her a spot among the "Hime 6," the prestigious titles awarded only to the top six candidates in Himegasaki Academy's famous general election. Determined to claim a throne of her own, Ayane forces Yuuma to use his weakness as leverage, making him "conquer" her rival princess candidates and clear the path to her victory.

But winning over the school's most dazzling girls, who have the entire student body captivated, is no easy task, and Yuuma struggles at every turn... Worse still, as he gets involved, he finds himself tangled in the increasingly complicated romantic entanglements of the princesses themselves!

19c29657-26ab-48e0-b480-4fdd8bf42c21.title: Ouji wa Sakete Toorenai!
19c29657-26ab-48e0-b480-4fdd8bf42c21.description:
For Kaname, who's never been good around boys, an all-girls school is practically paradise.

She doesn't mind being plain or keeping to herself. As long as she can enjoy her days in peace, that's enough for her... Though deep down, she'd love to experience a little high school excitement!

But one day, Kaname accidentally discovers a side of Ritsuka Ouji, one of the legendary "Four Princes" who reign over the school, that no one else has ever seen.

Terrified that Ritsuka might silence her to keep the secret, Kaname braces herself... only for the prince to make her a rather unexpected offer...
